title: One 30X social post as observed by hand: its public counts at one moment
description: Filled by the maintainer by looking at 30X's public posts (no automation, no scraping), in templates/social_posts_template.csv, saved as lake/manual/social_posts.csv; imported by pipelines/social/importer.py to lake/gold/social_post_metrics.parquet. Private to 30X: never committed, never mocked; only aggregates leave the lake, and only with 30X's consent.

post_key.description: your own id: li-001, x-001, ig-001

account.description: the 30X account the post belongs to, e.g. the company page

observed_at.description: when you read the counts; counts keep growing, so this is required

post_text.description: the post's text, or its first lines; the Curator labels the topic from it

topic_hint.description: optional: what the post is about, in your words

is_ai_topic.description: optional: your own yes/no on whether it is about AI (a human label)

views.description: public views/impressions when the platform shows them (X, Instagram reels); null otherwise

shares.description: reposts or shares; null where the platform hides them

saves.description: bookmarks or saves when shown; null otherwise

engagement.description: derived: reactions + comments + shares + saves (missing ones count as 0)
